content.study:
Section 86 — Repeal and saving

Section 86 repeals the Arbitration and Conciliation (Third) Ordinance, 1996 and saves orders, rules, notifications, schemes, acts and actions taken under that Ordinance by deeming them to have been made, done or taken under corresponding provisions of the Act.

The section is a savings/repeal provision. Its transitional effect must be applied according to the statutory commencement dates and express saving language.
